entities.summary: Gustave Henri Ange Hippolyte Rolin-Jaequemyns was a Belgian lawyer, diplomat, politician and Minister of the Interior (1878–1884) as a member of the Unitarian Liberal Party. He was the son of Hippolyte Rolin, the son in law of Edouard Jaequemyns, the brother of Albéric Rolin, the father of Edouard Rolin-Jaequemyns, and the uncle of Henri Rolin.Together with the Swiss jurist Gustave Moynier, he founded the Institut de Droit International and became its first Honorary President.
